_readme.en: Owner: Set C with Mohammed. Arabic register: simple Modern Standard Arabic, one register for every machine; Viking sounds older and slower. Each line is one breath, under 12 English words. Final so far: ch0_wake, ch0_fold, ch1_intro, ch1_dust, ch1_fixed, ch1_left_behind. Lines still marked (placeholder) are written in task C-4. who = lrv | opportunity | viking | ingenuity | pioneer. emotion = curious | happy | scared | sad | sleepy.

ch1_dust.en: I'm sorry. I'm making a mess.

ch1_fixed.en: You fixed me. With a map!

ch1_left_behind.en: Oh. I was only for the ride.
